mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_id, user_name, password, account, status, balance, integral, credit, level, avatar, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{account}, #{status}, #{balance}, #{integral}, #{credit}, #{level}, #{avatar}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user where account = #{account} and password = #{password} and deleted = 0
SELECT user_name FROM user WHERE account = #{string} AND deleted = 0
SELECT account, user_name FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
